caption: The drawing shows a rectangular red and black frame containing a central memorial composition on a cream-colored background. Within the frame, there is a large, oval-shaped wreath made of dark purple leaves. At the top center of the wreath, there is a small blue ribbon or banner with the words "AT REST" written on it. Surrounding the wreath are several tan or light brown bird and animal figures facing inward, with two birds positioned near the top and what appear to be two lambs or similar animals on either side. Inside the wreath, closer to the center, there is a depiction of a gravestone or memorial plaque, shaded in brown and black, with a large overhanging willow tree drawn in brown and black lines above it, its branches drooping over the gravestone. At the center of the gravestone is a simple cross, and the words "IN MEMORY OF" and "THOMAS M. JONES" are written in gold letters. Below the gravestone, there are more gold letters that read "Born Jan 9th 1873 Died Apr 5th 1881". The overall structure of the drawing is symmetrical and all the text is clearly centered within the ornate foliage and figures.
title: Framed Paper Cutting
